description.zh:
导播台ID。
- 如果您通过[CreateCaster接口](~~2848009~~)创建导播台，请查看CreateCaster接口调用返回的参数CasterId值。

- 如果您通过直播控制台创建导播台，请通过**直播控制台** > **导播台** > **云导播台**页面查看。

> 直播控制台云导播台页面导播台列表中的导播台名称即导播台ID。
description.en:
The ID of the production studio.

- If you created the production studio by calling the [CreateCaster](~~2848009~~) operation, use the CasterId value returned in the response.

- If you created the production studio in the ApsaraVideo Live console, go to the **Production Studio** > **Cloud Production Studio** page in the **ApsaraVideo Live console** to view the ID.

> The name of the production studio in the list on the Cloud Production Studio page is the production studio ID.

description.zh:
组件ID列表，数组内按照由下至上的顺序排列组件。 >N表示第几个的意思。例如：
ComponentId.1表示第一个组件ID，
ComponentId.2表示第二个组件ID。
description.en:
The list of component IDs. The components in the array are ordered from bottom to top.

> N specifies the position of the component. For example, ComponentId.1 is the first component ID and ComponentId.2 is the second component ID.

description.zh: 布局ID。如果您通过[DescribeCasterLayouts接口](~~2848028~~)查询导播台布局列表，请查看DescribeCasterLayouts接口调用返回的参数LayoutId值。
description.en: The layout ID. If you query the layout list for the production studio by calling the [DescribeCasterLayouts](~~2848028~~) operation, use the LayoutId value returned in the response.

title.zh: 全量设置导播台场景配置

descriptions.zh:
调用本接口全量设置场景配置，清空场景配置，并将布局信息设置并生效至指定场景。

## QPS限制
本接口的单用户QPS限制为10次/秒。超过限制，API调用会被限流，这可能会影响您的业务，请合理调用。
descriptions.en:
This operation sets all configurations for a scene. It clears the existing configuration and applies the new layout to the specified scene.

## QPS limit

The queries per second (QPS) limit for this API is 10 calls per second per user. API calls that exceed this limit are throttled, which may affect your business. Plan your API calls to avoid service interruptions.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun live set-caster-scene-config --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --component-id a2b8e671-2fe5-4642-a2ec-bf9318260000 --caster-id 80787064-1c94-4dc1-85ce-9409960a0000 --scene-id 242b4e2c-c30f-4442-85ba-2e3e4e3d0000 --layout-id 0c6da077-f037-49e8-8440-3be133930000 --region cn-hangzhou
